# The crawl behind this suite

- **the-internet.herokuapp.com.crawl.json**: every page the crawl read: its URL, status, redirects, title,
  headings, links and where it sits in the site. (Over 20 MB it is kept compressed: `.crawl.json.gz`.)
- **the-internet.herokuapp.com.templates.json**: the page types the pages were grouped into, and the site's menu.
- **manifest.json**: which Suite Builder version made the suite, when, and from which crawl.
- **identities.json**: each page type's identity, kept across rebuilds, and where it stands now.

Rebuild the suite from it (no crawling): `suite build the-internet-herokuapp-com-cypress-tests`. Crawl again: `suite build the-internet.herokuapp.com`.
